tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms & conditions are as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: a.Manufacturers or their authorized Dealers with a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 8.00 crores for the preceding continuous three years (i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-2025).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- SUBMIT THE DOCUMENTS AS PER THE PREQUALIFICATION CRITERIA OF THE TENDER.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Additional Format duly filled, sealed & signed
Any other documents in respect of Prequalification criteria and other Terms and conditions of tender.

Certificate of Incorporation/ Certificate of Registration issued by the Registrar of Companies/ Industries and Commerce Dept in proof of manufacturing status-along with MOA or Annexures/ enclosures to certificate-showing nature Buisbess/ Service rendered / Product manufactured
Certification of Verification issued by the Chartered Accountant in the format prescribed
Declaration-I as per the format on Govt. stamp paper of Rs. 20/- or above
Declaration-II as per the format on Govt. stamp paper of Rs. 20/-or above-In case the manufacturers/ Principal firm will execute supplies through their Channel Partner/ Authorized Dealer/ Distributor
Declaration-III as per the format on Govt. stamp paper of Rs. 20/-or above
For the preciding continuous three years-Annual GST return acknowledged by the concerned Commercial Tax Officer for the year i.e. 2022-23,2023-24 & 2024-25
For the preciding continuous three years-Audited Statement of Accounts-Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet-for the year i.e. 2022-23,2023-24 & 2024-25
NSIC Certificate-To avail exemption from EMD
Tender specific authorisation letter from OEM - in case of Authorised dealer.
